# Init Project

- Create a NextJS project using "npx create-next-app@latest --use-pnpm"
- Require libs:
  - shadcn ui
  - react query - api communication
  - jotai - state management
  - react player - video plays
  - embla-carousel
  - sharp - images optimize

2, Folder structures

- Below is the folder list (create it as needed)
  - types folder for interfaces, types
  - utils folder for helper functions
  - component folder for components
    - ui component for buttons, link...
  - service folder for apis, services
  - constants folder for const
  - hooks folder for custom hooks
